```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
ParquetFileReader$create("data/daily_prices.parquet")$GetSchema()
```

```{r}
open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  collect() |>
  slice_sample(n = 10)
```

```{r}
open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  filter(date_raw >= "2025-01-01") |>
  group_by(coin_id) |>
  summarise(average_market_cap_usd = mean(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  arrange(desc(average_market_cap_usd)) |>
  collect()
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
prices <- read_parquet("data/daily_prices.parquet")
metadata <- read_parquet("data/coin_metadata.parquet")
categories <- read_parquet("data/categories.parquet")

crypto <- prices |>
  left_join(metadata, by = "coin_id") |>
  left_join(
    categories |> rename(category_description = description),
    by = "category_id"
  ) |>
  mutate(date = ymd(date_raw))
```

```{r}
metadata <- metadata |>
  mutate(launch_date_parsed = coalesce(
    ymd(launch_date, quiet = TRUE),
    mdy(launch_date, quiet = TRUE)
  ))

metadata |>
  arrange(launch_date_parsed) |>
  select(coin = coin_id, name = coin_name, launch_date, launch_date_parsed)
```

```{r}
crypto |>
  filter(coin_id == "btc") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = price_usd)) +
  geom_line()
```

```{r}
crypto |>
  group_by(date, category_name) |>
  summarise(category_market_cap_usd = sum(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  group_by(date) |>
  mutate(category_share = category_market_cap_usd / sum(category_market_cap_usd)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(category_name = fct_reorder(
    category_name, category_share, .fun = median, .desc = TRUE
  )) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = category_share, fill = category_name)) +
  geom_area() +
  geom_rect(
    data = tibble(
      start = ymd(c("2022-05-07", "2022-11-08")),
      end = ymd(c("2022-05-13", "2022-11-12"))
    ),
    aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = 0, ymax = 1),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "white",
    alpha = 0.35,
    color = "grey30",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  annotate(
    "label",
    x = ymd(c("2022-05-09", "2022-11-10")),
    y = 0.97,
    label = c("Luna/UST crash", "FTX collapse"),
    size = 3,
    label.size = 0.2
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "C", end = 0.9) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_percent(),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Crypto Market-Cap Share by Category",
    subtitle = "Daily share of combined market cap across the 22 coins in this dataset; categories sum to 100%.",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Share of combined market cap",
    fill = "Category",
    caption = "Source: daily_prices.parquet; category labels from coin_metadata.parquet and categories.parquet."
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```
